name: Dehumidifier
definition: A portable household appliance that removes moisture from indoor air using a refrigerated condensing or documented adsorption process and provides a means to collect or drain the resulting condensate.
includedScope: Portable adsorption dehumidifiers when the process and rating method are documented
excludedScope: Room air conditioners and portable air conditioners
Whole-building dehumidification and industrial process dryers
Humidifiers, air purifiers without moisture removal and unverified cross-model parts
primaryApplications: Indoor humidity management in occupied rooms
Basement or utility-space moisture removal within source-stated limits
Bucket, gravity-drain or built-in-pump operation approved for the exact model
headline: Dehumidifier extraction ratings, drainage and buyer checks
description: This profile separates moisture-removal rating and test condition, refrigeration or adsorption process, room-area convention, temperature range, bucket and drainage modes, filtration, defrost, controls and service parts so buyers can compare exact portable dehumidifiers without treating pint or litre labels as universal capacity.
metaDescription: Portable dehumidifier guide covering extraction test conditions, drainage, models, standards, installation and component checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not indoor-air-quality, mold-remediation, refrigerant-service, electrical or drainage advice. Correct active leaks and confirm the exact regional model, manual, rating condition, room temperature, supply, clearance, bucket, hose, pump and service-part numbers before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Rating boundary
keyFacts.value: Moisture-removal capacity is meaningful only with the stated temperature, humidity and test method
keyFacts.evidence: DOE Appendix X1 uses defined conditions; LG explicitly notes the US test change from 80°F to 65°F for its pint rating.
keyFacts.scope: Exact model, jurisdiction and rating condition.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match extraction, low-temperature operation, tank, gravity drain or pump, hose routing and service parts to the exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Official manufacturer pages show different bucket, pump, drain, defrost, temperature and control arrangements.

systemFlow.name: Air intake and sensing
systemFlow.componentFamily: Filter, inlet grille, fan, humidity and temperature sensors and controller
systemFlow.role: Draws room air through the appliance and determines when moisture removal should operate.
systemFlow.evidence: Official pages and manuals document washable filters, fan speeds, humidistats and control ranges.

systemFlow.name: Moisture removal
systemFlow.componentFamily: Evaporator, condenser, compressor, expansion device, refrigerant and defrost control
systemFlow.role: Cools process air below its dew point, condenses moisture and reheats discharged air in refrigerated models.
systemFlow.evidence: DOE defines the refrigerated surface, refrigerating system and air-circulating fan for covered consumer dehumidifiers.
systemFlow.scope: US refrigerated consumer dehumidifier definition; adsorption variants require their own evidence.

systemFlow.name: Condensate handling
systemFlow.componentFamily: Drip tray, bucket, float switch, gravity drain, pump where fitted and hose
systemFlow.role: Collects water and stops, drains or pumps it according to the configured mode.
systemFlow.evidence: Midea, LG, Hisense, GE and Haier publish distinct bucket and drainage options.
systemFlow.scope: Exact hose, lift, routing and installation instructions.

variants.name: Bucket and gravity-drain dehumidifier
variants.taskScale: Portable room or basement humidity management
variants.operatorRelationship: User empties the bucket or routes a continuously falling hose to an approved drain
variants.spaceConstraints: Air clearance, level floor, hose fall and service access
variants.limitations: Continuous drain requires correct gravity routing and does not prove a built-in pump.
variants.evidence: Midea and Hisense publish bucket and garden-hose drainage arrangements.

variants.name: Built-in pump dehumidifier
variants.taskScale: Sites where condensate must be lifted within the source-stated limit
variants.operatorRelationship: User connects the approved pump hose and maintains the bucket and filter
variants.spaceConstraints: Pump head, hose route, power, overflow protection and discharge point
variants.limitations: Pump presence and lift capability are model-specific and do not replace leak control.
variants.evidence: LG UD501KOJ5 and selected Midea models publish built-in pump functions.

performanceMetrics.name: Moisture-removal capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Water condensed per day under a defined air temperature and relative humidity
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: US pints/day and regional litres/day may use different test conditions
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not rank nominal 50-pint, 16 L/day or 30 L/day labels without their conditions.
performanceMetrics.evidence: DOE defines the US test procedure; LG records the 65°F method change; Sharp states 30 L/day at 30°C and 80% RH.
performanceMetrics.scope: Named test condition and exact model.

performanceMetrics.name: Integrated energy factor
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Source-declared litres of water removed per kilowatt-hour under the applicable test
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Capacity class, test condition and regulation version matter
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Energy certification does not establish site extraction or room coverage.
performanceMetrics.evidence: DOE regulates IEF under Appendix X1 and ENERGY STAR identifies qualified dehumidifiers.
performanceMetrics.scope: US covered products and current certification record.

performanceMetrics.name: Room area and low-temperature operation
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Manufacturer guidance for application scale and minimum operating conditions
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Moisture load, air exchange, temperature, drainage and duty cycle are not standardized by a room-area headline
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Square-foot coverage is not a substitute for moisture-load calculation or witnessed performance.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific area and low-temperature statements; LG specifies 41°F low-temperature operation for UD501KOG5.

applicationFit.application: Damp room or basement humidity management
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Correct active water entry first, then log room temperature, RH and collected water during a witnessed trial.
applicationFit.assessment: Correct active water entry first, then log room temperature, RH and collected water during a witnessed trial.
applicationFit.basis: Envelope moisture, infiltration, temperature, air mixing and appliance duty interact.
applicationFit.limitations: A room-area or pint label does not prove mold remediation or whole-site control.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record 24-hour temperature/RH, bucket mass or drain volume, runtime and power before scaling.
applicationFit.evidence: DOE and ENERGY STAR distinguish appliance ratings from site selection guidance.
applicationFit.scope: Portable indoor use within manual limits.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Witness bucket-full shutdown, gravity flow or pump operation and verify the discharge path cannot backflow or leak.
applicationFit.assessment: Witness bucket-full shutdown, gravity flow or pump operation and verify the discharge path cannot backflow or leak.
applicationFit.basis: Float, pump, hose elevation and drain routing determine water handling.
applicationFit.limitations: Continuous mode does not remove the need for inspection or leak correction.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Attach hose size, fall or lift, discharge point and overflow response to the site record.
applicationFit.evidence: Official manuals describe distinct gravity and pump arrangements.
applicationFit.scope: Exact model and installed hose configuration.

componentStack.name: Air, filter and sensor system
componentStack.role: Moves room air and controls operation against measured humidity and temperature.
criticalChecks: Air clearance and fan part number
componentStack.evidence: Official product pages publish different filter, fan and control configurations.
componentStack.scope: Exact model and serial family; no cross-model fit.

componentStack.name: Refrigeration and defrost system
componentStack.role: Condenses atmospheric moisture and restores heat to the discharge air.
componentStack.evidence: DOE defines the covered refrigeration assembly; LG publishes compressor, refrigerant and automatic defrost data.
componentStack.scope: Exact label and qualified refrigerant service.

componentStack.name: Bucket, float and drainage system
componentStack.role: Collects condensate and prevents or routes overflow.
criticalChecks: Hose diameter, fall or pump head
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific bucket, gravity and pump features.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Maintain a target indoor relative humidity
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Site moisture load, extraction under actual conditions, runtime and drainage
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by pints/day, litres/day or square feet without test conditions
procurementDecisions.assessment: Use a logged site trial and measured condensate.
procurementDecisions.basis: Extraction falls or changes with temperature, RH, airflow and duty cycle.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No catalogue rating proves building-wide control or mold remediation.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Compare like-for-like results at recorded temperature and RH.
procurementDecisions.evidence: DOE, LG and Sharp expose materially different rating boundaries.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Control unattended drainage and lifecycle cost
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Bucket, float, hose, pump, filter, sensor and refrigeration support
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming all continuous-drain models pump water uphill or share parts
procurementDecisions.assessment: Price the exact drainage configuration and five-year service parts.
procurementDecisions.basis: Gravity and pump systems, hose limits and assemblies differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future part availability and site drainage reliability are not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain exact hose, pump, bucket, float, filter and sensor codes in writing.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official model sources publish distinct water-handling systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: An undersized portable appliance cannot correct active leaks, unsuitable temperature or uncontrolled air exchange.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Document water entry, room volume, temperature/RH trend and required duty before sizing.
engineeringChecks.evidence: DOE defines portable product performance while manufacturer limits remain model-specific.

engineeringChecks.reason: The appliance combines mains power, condensate water and a sealed refrigerant circuit.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Use a compliant outlet, level placement, approved hose route and qualified sealed-system service.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official manuals and DOE product definition identify these systems.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact regional product and local rules.

standards.name: 10 CFR Part 430, Subpart B, Appendix X1
standards.applicability: US test procedure for consumer dehumidifier capacity and integrated energy factor.
standards.evidence: DOE directs manufacturers to Appendix X1 for current compliance testing.
standards.scope: US covered consumer dehumidifiers; confirm effective dates and product class.

standards.name: ENERGY STAR Dehumidifiers Program Requirements
standards.applicability: Certification and product-selection framework for eligible dehumidifiers.
standards.evidence: EPA publishes the dehumidifier program and Product Finder.
standards.scope: Verify the exact model in the current certified-products record.

developments.title: US portable dehumidifier rating condition changed
developments.summary: LG's official specification notes that the DOE pint-removal test condition changed from 80°F under the earlier procedure to 65°F under the later Appendix X1 basis.
developments.evidence: LG's UD501KOG5 specification states both temperature bases and cites the DOE appendices.
developments.scope: US pint-removal labeling context; not a conversion formula between products.
